title: R5 content-hash change-signal
description: Cache-invalidation signal emitted by makima on each work-state record so project-rag can invalidate its CQRS projection cache on change. Content-hash (sha256 of the raw source file body), NOT mtime, NOT git-rev. mtime alone is REJECTED for product-facing reads (R5). Convention mirrors coordinator_core/cache.py compute_stamp (Design Decision D2). Spec: coordinator_core/contract/project-rag-producer-contract.md § 3.

algo.description: Hash algorithm. Fixed literal 'sha256' (reserved for future algorithm agility).

hex.description: sha256(<raw source file body bytes>).hexdigest() — lowercase 64-char hex. Identical convention to coordinator_core/cache.py compute_stamp.

source_path.description: Repo-relative path of the source artifact the hash was taken over. Matches the record's provenance.path. rag keys its projection cache on (source_path, hex).
